text: Near Earth, they let the service module go, and saw the damage for the first time. A whole side was missing. They brought the frozen Odyssey back to life, using a power-up plan worked out on the ground. Then they let go of Aquarius, the lifeboat that had saved them. On April the seventeenth, nineteen seventy, Odyssey splashed down in the Pacific. All three astronauts were safe.
